theater: 河北鄴城、河南楊劉至開封

battle.name: 後唐滅後梁之戰
battle.theater: 河北鄴城、河南楊劉至開封
battle.brief: 同光元年（923），晉王李存勖自河東晉陽出兵，拔鄴城、下楊劉、敗王彥章於中都，十月進軍開封，梁末帝朱友貞自焚，後梁亡。卡面的希臘重步兵早於此役一千四百餘年，靠盾牌相接的方陣取勝；五百年前的中原，取勝的已是騎兵集群與雲梯、排車。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是五代前期最後一場王朝更替之戰，交戰主體是河北與河南兩大軍事集團的正面決戰。一方是後梁：朱溫以河南為本，一九零七年篡唐建梁，都汴州，歷十六年而不倒；其軍隊骨架是各鎮節度使的州鎮兵，核心是拱衛京師的殿前司與內外軍，梁廷以樞密院掌軍機，名將段凝、王景仁、王彥章各領一路，汴京一帶的糧秣、鹽鐵與汴河漕運是它的財政與兵源命脈。另一方是李克用一手帶出的晉集團：以太原為根本，靠河東鹽池與馬政養出沙陀精騎，節度使與親兵、牙軍並行；李存勖承襲晉王位後，掌控河東、河北與趙州、鎮州一線，樞密使郭崇韜掌軍務，李嗣源、符存審、史建瑭、李存審分統大軍。晉梁之外，場邊的第三方同樣在算帳：北面契丹與幽州盧龍軍在燕雲一線拉鋸，吳越、南唐、前蜀、楚各自遣使觀望，沒有一方願意先押錯注；於是這場戰爭的勝負，最後只由河南大地上這兩支軍隊自己決定。
countriesEn: This war was the last dynastic transition of the early Five Dynasties, fought as a direct collision between the two great military groups of Hebei and Henan. On one side stood the Later Liang: Zhu Wen, based in Henan, usurped the Tang in 907, founded the Liang, made Bianzhou his capital, and his dynasty survived sixteen years. The skeleton of his armies was the troops of the circuits ruled by the jiedushi, with the core formed by the Palace Guard and the inner and outer guards that defended the capital; the Liang court handled military affairs through the Privy Council, and the commanders Duan Ning, Wang Jingren and Wang Yanzhang each led a separate force. The grain, salt and iron of the Bian River region and the canal transport that fed Bianzhou were the regime's fiscal and manpower lifeline. On the other side stood the Jin group built by Li Keyong: rooted in Taiyuan, sustained by the salt pools of Hedong and by the horse-breeding of the north, it combined circuit armies with the personal guards and tooth soldiers of the commander. After Li Cunxu inherited the title Prince of Jin, he held Hedong, Hebei and the line of Zhaozhou and Zhenzhou, with the Privy Councillor Guo Chongtao managing military affairs and Li Siyuan, Fu Cunshen, Shi Jianhuang and Li Cunshen each commanding a wing of the army. Third parties on the fringe were weighing the odds as well: in the north the Khitan and the Lulong army of Youzhou ground against each other along the Yan-Yun frontier, while Wuyue, Southern Tang, Former Shu and Chu all sent envoys to watch; not one of them wanted to bet on the wrong side. The issue therefore came down to the two armies standing on the plains of Henan.
people: 全場的樞紐是晉王李存勖。他三十歲上下，剛從養父李克用手上接過河東兵權，卻已決定用一場戰爭解決名分問題：他不只打算滅梁，還要自稱承繼唐室，國號大唐。他用兵不拘一格，鄴城之役前先取趙州、鎮州，令趙州刺史元行欽開城內應，再以排車雲梯晝夜攻城，同時迎擊樞密使王景仁的援軍，逼得景仁夜遁而走；這一路的果斷，與年輕氣盛同樣明顯。晉軍的實際統兵者是李嗣源，李克用養子、李存勖之兄，本名李亞子，曾在胡柳陂受創，其老練狠辣在五代堪稱第一；正是他率五千精騎南下，連下鄆州、鄆州一帶，切斷梁軍後路。將領之中，李存審、符存審、史建瑭各領一翼攻城，樞密使郭崇韜主持軍務，籌措糧餉與器械。梁方則是另一種光景：末帝朱友貞在梁廷內孤立無援，仍死守汴州；樞密使王景仁在鄴城敗後再無士氣；北面招討使段凝在楊劉一線全軍覆沒；最後的名將王彥章以大軍北討，兵敗中都，不肯屈膝而死；樞密敬翔則在城破之日不肯降唐，據舊史記載舉家自殉。
peopleEn: The pivot of the whole campaign was the Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu. Around thirty years old, he had just taken over the military power of Hedong from his adoptive father Li Keyong, and he had already decided to settle the question of legitimacy with a war: he did not mean merely to destroy the Liang, but to proclaim himself heir to the Tang court under the title of Great Tang. He fought without much regard for convention. Before the action at Ye he took Zhaozhou and Zhenzhou, had the governor of Zhaozhou, Yuan Xingqin, open the gates from within, and then assaulted the city day and night with battering carts and scaling ladders while simultaneously meeting the relief army of the Privy Councillor Wang Jingren, driving that general into a night retreat. The decisiveness of that march was as visible as the youthfulness behind it. The man who actually commanded the Jin field forces was Li Siyuan, the adopted son of Li Keyong and elder brother of Li Cunxu, born Li Yazi, who had been badly wounded at Huliupo and whose cunning and ferocity were unmatched in the Five Dynasties. It was he who led five thousand picked riders south, taking Yunzhou and Yuncheng in turn and cutting the rear of the Liang army. Among the other commanders, Li Cunshen, Fu Cunshen and Shi Jianhuang each led a wing in the siege, while the Privy Councillor Guo Chongtao directed military affairs and the supply of food and equipment. The Liang side was a very different picture. The last emperor, Zhu Youzhen, isolated within his own court, still held Bianzhou to the last. The Privy Councillor Wang Jingren never recovered his confidence after the defeat at Ye. The Commander of the Northern Front, Duan Ning, lost his entire army around Yangliu. The last outstanding general of the Liang, Wang Yanzhang, marched north with a massed army, was defeated at Zhongdu, and died rather than submit. The Privy Councillor Jing Xiang refused to surrender to the Tang on the day the city fell; the old histories record that he took his whole family with him.
kits: 本役交鋒的是五代中原的騎兵、步卒與攻城器械組合。晉軍骨幹是沙陀精騎：騎士著皮甲或札甲，戴兜鍪與護臂，佩環首刀與直刀，刀身修直、柄首加環，斬馬足、砍鎧皆宜，近身用長柄刀與馬槊，馬上用角木為骨、桑皮為腹的弓，並配標槊供高速衝鋒與超越射擊。步兵以長槊橫陣與陌刀列陣，披大盾遮蔽身體，用雙戟與弓弩補殺傷。攻城一端更見五代水準：雲梯、巢車、排車、撞車、飛石砲齊備，晉軍曾以排車臨鄴城城牆，晝夜輟攻，又用衝車撞門；守城一方則倚城頭弩陣（床子弩、偏廂弩）、拒馬、鹿角、繩索飛梯與火攻，城內備有飛火、發火機一類火藥器械，此類記載見於《新五代史》所記吳越焚舟之役。運輸方面，晉軍靠河東至趙州、魏州的饋運線與沿途倉場，梁軍則取汴河漕運與州鎮賦稅，舟車、帳幕、鼓角、旗幟同樣是戰力的組成。卡面的希臘重步兵是這場戰爭的反面：方陣的力量來自盾牌相接、人人遮蔽，公元前五世紀的希臘人靠整體結構換取正面強度；而九二三年的中原，決定勝負的已是騎兵集群的機動與攻城器械的組織力，個人之勇讓位於編制之功。
kitsEn: What clashed in this war was the combined system of cavalry, infantry and siege equipment of the Central Plain in the Five Dynasties. The backbone of the Jin army was the Shatuo cavalry. Riders wore leather or lamellar armour with helmets and arm guards, and carried ring-pommel sabres and straight swords whose blades were long and straight with a ring at the pommel, equally at home cutting a horse's leg or biting through plate. At close quarters they used long-handled sabres and long lances; on horseback they shot with bows of horn and sinew on a mulberry core, and carried lighter javelins for the fast charge and for shooting at range. The infantry fought in long-spear lines and with long cutting swords, their bodies covered by large shields, supported by double-ended polearms and crossbows. At the other end of the spectrum the siege warfare had reached a recognisably Five Dynasties standard: scaling ladders, observation towers, battering carts, battering rams and stone-throwing engines were all to hand. The Jin brought battering carts up against the walls of Ye and kept up the assault day and night, and used rams against the gates. The defenders relied on the crossbow line along the walls, with heavy crossbows and flanking pieces, on cheval-de-frise, caltrops, rope ladders and fire attack, and the city contained devices of the fire-weapon kind, the kind of thing recorded in the New History of the Five Dynasties in the account of Wuyue burning ships. On the logistics side the Jin drew on the supply line running from Hedong through Zhaozhou to Weizhou and on the depots along it, while the Liang drew on the canal transport of the Bian and on the taxes of the circuits; carts and boats, tents, drums, horns and banners were all part of the fighting power. The Greek hoplite on this card is the opposite of the war itself: the strength of the phalanx came from shields touching and men covering one another, and the Greeks of the fifth century BCE bought the strength of their frontage through the structure of the whole. In the Central Plain of 923 what decided the issue was the mobility of clustered cavalry and the organisation of siege equipment; individual valour had yielded to the discipline of the formation.
tactics: 此役的戰法可歸納為三段。第一段是奇襲與強攻並行：晉軍自井陘出太行，兵不血刃而據趙州，刺史元行欽為內應開城；轉而南下魏州，以排車、雲梯夾晝夜進攻鄴城，同時在城南迎擊王景仁的援軍，斷其糧道而後拔城。第二段是渡河與據險：段凝屯兵楊劉，晉軍以舟師自白馬津一帶濟黃河，騎兵先渡而後布陣立柵，段凝所部潰散，晉軍遂得東岸立足之地，並把戰線推到汴州牆下。第三段是野戰殲滅與攻城滅國：王彥章統大軍自北南下，晉軍不與其正面硬撼，而以騎兵集群不斷切入、分割其橫陣，兩翼同時迂迴，最終在中都一戰俘其主將；其後大軍直抵開封城下，圍而不急攻，唯斷漕運、絕糧道、離其內外，城中人心先崩。城頭的抵抗終止於衝撞與火攻，末帝退入後殿自焚，一座經營十六年的都城就此易主。
tacticsEn: The method of this war can be reduced to three stages. The first combined surprise with assault. The Jin came out of Jingxing over the Taihang, took Zhaozhou without a battle because the governor Yuan Xingqin opened the gates from within, and turned south to Weizhou; there they assaulted the city of Ye with battering carts and scaling ladders day and night while simultaneously meeting the relief army of Wang Jingren to the south of the town, and only after cutting that army's supply did they take the walls. The second stage was the crossing and the securing of the bank. Duan Ning was posted at Yangliu, and the Jin sent their river craft across the Yellow River in the neighbourhood of Baimajin; the cavalry crossed first, formed up and planted their stakes, Duan Ning's command broke up, and the Jin gained its footing on the eastern bank with the line pushed right up to the walls of Bianzhou. The third stage was the destruction of the enemy in the open field followed by the reduction of the city. When Wang Yanzhang led his army south from the north, the Jin refused to meet him head on, but cut into and split his line with clusters of horse, turning both wings at once, and finally took his commander captive at Zhongdu. Then the main host came down on Bianzhou, invested the city without hurrying the assault, and simply cut the canal, starved the food route and detached the inner from the outer quarters, so that the morale of the city broke before the walls did. The resistance on the wall ended under ram and fire; the last emperor withdrew to the rear hall and set fire to himself, and a capital built over sixteen years changed hands in a single day.
data: 時間上，此役自同光元年正月晉軍出師，至同年十月汴州陷落，前後約十個月，較大的會戰有三場：魏州鄴城之戰、汶上中都之戰、開封城下之戰。兵力方面，梁方以十萬精兵北討，據史書記「集精兵十萬」，是梁朝最後一次傾國而出的調度；晉軍出師兵馬為數萬，以河東精騎為骨幹，兼取趙州、鎮州與河北諸鎮之兵，另由李嗣源率精騎五千直趨鄆州，說明晉軍善用小股奇兵。距離上，晉陽至鄴城官道約八百里，鄴城至楊劉約四百里，楊劉至開封約二百五十里，一條黃河南岸的通道串起全戰線，騎兵一日可馳一百二十里上下。消耗方面，鄴城攻城與中都野戰各折梁軍精騎數千，末戰之前梁軍可用之兵已不足主力之半；開封城破時，梁廷禁軍多不戰而散。政權壽命上，後梁自九零七年立國至此凡十六年，後唐自九二三年立國至九三七年亡，凡十四年。
dataEn: As to time, the campaign ran from the first month of Tongguang in 923, when the Jin army set out, to the tenth month of the same year, when Bianzhou fell, a matter of roughly ten months, and there were three set-piece actions of consequence: the battle of Ye at Weizhou, the battle of Zhongdu in the district of Wen, and the investment of Bianzhou. On strength, the Liang mustered a hundred thousand picked troops for the northern march, the histories recording that ten wan of elite soldiers were assembled; it was the last time the Liang could gather everything it had for a single stroke. The Jin army numbered several tens of thousands on the march, with the Hedong horse as its backbone, joined by the troops of Zhaozhou, Zhenzhou and the other circuits of Hebei, while Li Siyuan took five thousand picked riders straight for Yunzhou, which shows how well the Jin used small columns for turning a flank. On distances, the post road from Jinyang to Ye runs about eight hundred li, from Ye to Yangliu about four hundred, and from Yangliu to Bianzhou about two hundred and fifty; a single corridor along the south bank of the Yellow River strung the whole front, and a horse could cover a little over a hundred li a day. On losses, the siege of Ye and the field action at Zhongdu between them cost the Liang several thousand picked riders, and by the eve of the last battle the Liang no longer had half of its main force available; when Bianzhou fell, much of the imperial guard simply dispersed without fighting. As to the life of the regimes, the Later Liang had lasted sixteen years from its foundation in 907, and the Later Tang would last fourteen years from its foundation in 923 until its fall in 937.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。第一層是十餘年的梁晉宿怨與地盤爭奪：自潞州之圍到河北易主，兩家的邊界始終沒有劃定，九一五年魏州軍兵變降晉，河北門戶洞開。第二層是李存勖的正當性追求：他自稱承唐室之後，要以討偽梁、興唐室的名分立國，滅梁既是軍略也是國策，因此寧可孤軍深入數百里，也不肯曠日持久。第三層是後梁的結構性弱點：末帝朱友貞與樞密、禁軍、外鎮彼此猜忌，段凝、王景仁、王彥章分兵不相統一，禁軍只知自保，州鎮兵不屬中樞節制；而汴京的存亡係於汴河漕運一線，一旦晉軍越過鄴城與楊劉，屏障與糧道同時失去。第四層是時機：梁軍主力西向攻澤州、潞州，河北與山東空虛，晉軍正是趁此空隙傾力南下，趕在梁軍回援之前把戰局壓到汴州城下。
causeEn: Four layers of cause lie behind the fighting. The first is the old enmity and the struggle for territory between the Liang and the Jin: from the siege of Liuzhou to the change of hands in Hebei, the border between the two houses was never drawn, and when the troops of Weizhou mutinied and went over to the Jin in 915 the gate into Hebei stood wide open. The second is Li Cunxu's pursuit of legitimacy: he claimed descent from the Tang court, meant to found his state on the title of destroying the false Liang and restoring the Tang, and so the destruction of the Liang was as much a policy as a strategy, which is why he was ready to drive a single army hundreds of li into enemy country rather than let the war drag on. The third is the structural weakness of the Later Liang: the last emperor Zhu Youzhen, the Privy Council, the imperial guard and the provincial commands all mistrusted one another; Duan Ning, Wang Jingren and Wang Yanzhang commanded separate forces that answered to no one, the guard thought only of its own survival, and the circuit troops were not under the central command. The survival of Bianzhou hung on a single line, the canal transport of the Bian; once the Jin passed Ye and Yangliu, both the shield and the supply were gone at the same time. The fourth is timing: with the Liang main force engaged westward against Zezhou and Liuzhou, Hebei and Shandong lay hollow, and the Jin poured south into that gap, driving the war up to the walls of Bianzhou before the Liang could come back.
impact: 此役的直接後果是梁亡唐興，十六年的後梁在開封的火焰中退場，後唐以同光年號承其緒，五代前期的中原第一次出現了以唐為號的王朝。此後的影響有三層。其一在名分與法統：後唐自認承唐正統，寬待舊臣，與後梁的偽梁之號相對，這種正統之爭延續到後唐亡後，遼人稱後唐為漢國，宋初修史仍把唐與後唐視為一體，五德終始之說也把後唐列於土德。其二在藩鎮格局：後唐雖得天下，卻仍靠河東、鄴都、昭義等鎮的兵與帥，節度使的實力不減反增，莊宗朝的高官厚祿與恩養驕兵，反而在十幾年後釀成明宗、末宗一連串兵變。其三在軍事技術：以排車、雲梯、飛石大規模攻城，以騎兵集群分割敵陣再合圍殲滅，這套打法在五代後期趨於成熟，後周世宗伐南唐與北宋削平諸國，都沿用同一套攻城與騎戰經驗。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this war was the end of the Liang and the rise of the Tang. Sixteen years of Later Liang went out in the fires at Bianzhou, and the Later Tang took up the thread under the Tongguang era; for the first time in the Central Plain of the early Five Dynasties there was a dynasty that bore the title of Tang. Three layers of consequence followed. The first concerns legitimacy and orthodoxy: the Later Tang held itself to be the inheritor of the Tang's proper succession, treated the former officials generously, and set itself against the title of false Liang. That contest over orthodoxy outlasted the dynasty, for the Khitan called the Later Tang the country of Han, and when the Northern Song began compiling its history it still treated the Tang and the Later Tang as one body, with the Later Tang counted among the succession of earth virtue. The second concerns the arrangement of the circuits: the Later Tang held the realm but still depended on the troops and the commanders of Hedong, Yedu, Zhaoyi and the other circuits, and the real power of the jiedushi grew rather than shrank. The generous stipends and the indulgence of the army under the Prince of Jin in the reign of the founding emperor would, a dozen years later, produce the string of mutinies under the second and fourth emperors. The third concerns military technique: sieges carried out on a large scale with battering carts, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines, and the destruction of enemy formations by cavalry clusters that split the line and then closed around it. That method matured in the later Five Dynasties, and both the campaigns of the Later Zhou emperor against Southern Tang and the Northern Song reduction of the remaining powers worked from the same experience of siege and mounted combat.
result: 結果是後梁覆亡。晉軍取趙州、鎮州，破王景仁於鄴城，下楊劉渡口，敗段凝；王彥章以大軍北討，兵敗中都，被擒不降，父子相繼而死；大軍直抵開封，糧道既絕、人心先散，樞密敬翔殉城，禁軍各自潰走，末帝朱友貞與數名近侍退入後殿，以火自焚，一代王朝就此終結。李存勖入汴州後詔告諸道，以洛陽為西都、汴州為東都，後唐開國。晉軍並非無損：攻城與野戰累有折耗，鎮州、趙州的降將不被信用，軍中已埋伏下猜忌與冗員之弊，莊宗末年的連串變亂其實始於此役之後的整軍與厚賞。梁亡而唐興，中原重歸一統，五代最長的一段分裂就此翻頁，但新王朝也把舊王朝的藩鎮難題一併承了下來。
resultEn: The result was the destruction of the Later Liang. The Jin took Zhaozhou and Zhenzhou, beat Wang Jingren at Ye, came down on the crossing at Yangliu and destroyed Duan Ning; Wang Yanzhang marched north with a massed army, was beaten at Zhongdu, refused to submit and was killed together with his sons. The main host then came up to Bianzhou, where the grain route was already cut and the morale of the city had already broken: the Privy Councillor Jing Xiang died with the city, the imperial guard melted away in every direction, and the last emperor Zhu Youzhen withdrew into the rear hall with a handful of close attendants and set fire to himself, ending a dynasty in a single night of fire. After entering Bianzhou, Li Cunxu proclaimed the news to the circuits, set Luoyang as the western capital and Bianzhou as the eastern, and the Later Tang was founded. The Jin were not untouched: the sieges and the field actions cost them men, the surrendered officers of Zhenzhou and Zhaozhou were not trusted, and the seeds of suspicion and redundancy were already planted in the army. The string of disturbances at the end of the founding emperor's reign began, in fact, with the reorganization and the generous rewards that followed this campaign. Liang fell and Tang rose, the Central Plain was united once more, and the longest division of the Five Dynasties was turned to a new page; but the new house inherited the old house's problem of the circuits along with everything else.
